٥×٥ يوضع بسر التداخل فحامله لا يهم بأمر الا فتح الله له بابا ومن اتخذه وردا لا يضطر إلى حاجة

أبدا وذلك بعد صوم ورياضة وصلاة ركعتين بالتسبيح وهي الباقيات الصالحات ويكون قبل قراءة

الفاتحة وبعملها ركوع وذكر أيضا واذا فرغ منه كذلك واذا سجد كذلك ويقرأ في الأولى يس والثانية

تبارك ويسأل حاجته تقضى وله من العدد ٨٨٩ وهو فرد مستطيل من الاسماء الوترية لفظا ورقا

لانه من ضرب ٧×١٣٧ وهو عدد ناقص أجزاؤه ١٢٥ تشير إلى اسمه المدني بالمافي الفتح من

الادناء وله من العدد ١٢٧ تشير إلى اسمه المؤمن بال وأما حروفه فهي ٤١٧ تشير إلى اسمين

جليلين وهما متين ماجد وهذا مربعه

(الفصل العشرون في اسمه تعالى عليم) هذا الاسم من أكثر من ذكره

أطلعه الله على دقائق الامور وخفيات العلوم ومن نقشه في صحيفة من زئبق

معقود في شرف عطارد وحملها معه أنطقه الله بالحكمة وعلمه لطائف المعارف

ومن وضعه في صحيفة من فضة في شرف المشتري وحملها رزقه الله الفهم في

العلوم الشرعية ويصلح ذكر لمن كان اسمه عيسى ومن كان اسمه سلطان

وهذه صورته وقد يوضع أيضا مثلثا وهذه صورته

ثم كان مظهر العلم من الارواح القدسية والارواح الخيرية اختص بتعليم الانبياء وكان من أشرفهم نبينا

محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم وأوحى اليه بالتواضع قال تعالى علمه شديد القوى ولما كانت الروح القدسية

العيساوية أثر النفخة الخيرية لا آدم عليه السلام وكان عيسى أشرف الانبياء بدقائق العلوم ولطائف

(Chapter Sixteen on His تعالى name Qahhār) Whoever calls by this name upon

an oppressor in seclusion, he is taken at his time. And whoever inscribes it in a square in the exaltation of Mars and carries it, then

he does not contend with anyone except he overcomes him and subdues him by argument. And it is suitable as a dhikr for whoever his name is ʿAbd al-Qahhār. And there is

(Chapter Seventeen on His تعالى name Wahhāb) Whoever persists in

its dhikr sees the provisions how they are divided. And whoever mentions it كثيرًا, God expands his provision.

And whoever inscribes it on paper in the exaltation of Saturn and carries it subdues his self and prevents it from desires.

And it is suitable as a dhikr for whoever his name is ʿAbd al-Wahhāb. And there is for it the number 14 in words and 602 in numerals. As for the names of its letters,

499, they indicate two noble names, and they are Fāṭir Muqsiṭ. And whoever remembers it asks nothing except that He gives it to him. And it is suitable

as a dhikr for whoever his name is Sulaymān, and it is from the odd and even secrets, so its oddness is in the consonant and its evenness in its number.

As for its numerical number, it is the even of the even and the lord of its quarters, and it is a number

deficient whose parts 356 indicate two names, and they are Muwaṣṣil Nūr; for it unites with the heart

in its parts, and therefore people’s rushing after provision destroyed them. And the seal of the name is exalted from

where do you eat? So he said: By God, the treasuries of the heavens and the earth. As for the names of its letters, they are 512,

indicating al-Muntaqim Qarīb. As for its square, this is the description. And whoever places His تعالى name Kāfī in a fortunate ascendant in a square

and looks at it much while he is remembering the name, and inscribes it on a body suitable for it after writing the square on the engraving tool, and

continues remembering it, then it will be an aid for him in everything he wants, from sufficiency against enemies and sufficiency for every important matter. And it should be

that the moon is increasing in light in a fortunate sign, and if the ascendant is stronger, then the most complete of deeds in truth.

(Chapter Nineteen on His تعالى name Fattāḥ) Whoever mentions this name كثيرًا, God opens

for him a door to his destination. And it is suitable for the wayfarers in the beginning of their states, and suitable for the arrivants in the end of their wayfaring. And there is for it a square

5×5 placed by the secret of interpenetration, so its bearer does not concern himself with any matter except that God opens for him a door. And whoever takes it as a litany is not compelled to a need

ever, and that after fasting and spiritual discipline and praying two rakʿahs with glorification, and they are the enduring righteous deeds, and it is before the recitation of

al-Fātiḥa and with its doing is bowing and dhikr also, and when he finishes from it likewise, and when he prostrates likewise, and he recites in the first Yā Sīn and in the second

Tabārak, and he asks his need, it is fulfilled. And there is for it the number 889, and it is an odd oblong among the names of oddness in word and in numeral,

because it is from the multiplication of 7×137, and it is a deficient number whose parts 125 indicate his civil name with the negation of opening from

the drawing near. And there is for it the number 127 indicating his name al-Mu’min with al-. As for its letters, they are 417, indicating two

noble names, and they are Matīn and Mājid. And this is its square

(Chapter Twenty on His تعالى name ʿAlīm) Whoever mentions this name كثيرًا,

God makes him aware of the subtleties of matters and the hidden things of the sciences. And whoever inscribes it on a sheet of mercury

bound in the exaltation of Mercury and carries it with him, God makes him speak with wisdom and teaches him the subtleties of knowledges.

And whoever places it on a sheet of silver in the exaltation of Jupiter and carries it, God provides him understanding in

the legal sciences. And it is suitable as a dhikr for whoever his name is ʿĪsā and whoever his name is Sulṭān.

And this is its form, and it may also be placed triangularly, and this is its form

— ١٦٨ —

الحكم، وكان من علومه علم الحرف، ومن ثم كان اسمه عنده، وهذه أمة عيسى لما يدل عليه من العلم،

والعين والياء من لطف التنزيل، والسين من جوامع التفضيل، والألف من الإحاطة، وكافُه من العدد

١٥٠ وذلك أعم علم، ولما كان من علم خفيات الأمر وقيل فيه عليم يشير إلى ذلك يكتب باسمه عليم فصار

عدده ١٤١، وأما أسماء حروفه ٢٩٢ فتشير إلى بصير، ولما كان العالم آية مظهرة للمطلوب متصلة به اتصالاً

تاماً، وقد يقال حصول عين متصلة بتمام المعنى، ولهذا لاحظ من قال: هو حصول صورة الشيء في الذهن،

فمعنى العلي على كل حال من ظهر له عين شيء ظهوراً متصلاً بظاهر كل شيء وباطنه، وهو من الأسرار

التي لا تصلح فيه المبالغة بالولما فيها من العلوم إلا بعد غايات جميع الموجودات، وإنما يبالغ فيه بأحد

أمرين: إما بالتكثير فيقال علّام فيكون للدلالة على التنزيل للدقائق وإدراك الحقائق، ولا يقال

عليم إلا لمن يعلم الدقائق كإيعلم الجلائل ويعلم الخفيات كإيعلم الجليات، قال تعالى: {وَفَوْقَ كُلِّ ذِي عِلْمٍ عَلِيمٌ}

فذو العلم من يعلم كليات الأمور، والعالم من يعلم ظواهر الأمور، والعليم من يعلم جليات الأمور وخفياتها،

وتذكر أن يجمع على كثير من العلماء فقال بالجزئيات، قال تعالى: {وَفَوْقَ كُلِّ ذِي عِلْمٍ} فإنه إن فوقية العلماء

على بعض لا تكون بكثرة المعلومات، إذ لو كانت كذلك لما قال لنبيه موسى عليه السلام لنعبد

عند مجمع البحرين يقال له الخضر وهو أعلم منك، ولم يكن الخضر عليه السلام أعلم من موسى بمعنى أنه

أكثر معلومات، كيف لا وقد قال الله تعالى في حق موسى: {وَكَتَبْنَا لَهُ فِي الْأَلْوَاحِ مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَّوْعِظَةً

وَتَفْصِيلًا لِّكُلِّ شَيْءٍ} وإنما المراد أنه يعلم بواطن معلوماته كإيعلم ظواهرها، ولذلك كان مكانه مجمع

البحرين اللذين هما بحر الظاهر والباطن، وقد اعترف لموسى بأنه على علم من علم الله لا يعلمه هو،

فاجتهد أيها الواقف على هذه الكلمات أن تكون عالماً علامة، وهذا هو المعنى الذي أمر الله نبيه

بطلبه في قوله: {وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا} وفضل العلم مشهور فتدبر المعنى والله الموفق.

(الفصل الحادي والعشرون في اسمه تعالى قابض) من ذكر هذا الاسم غلب عليه الجلال والهيبة

ولا يطيق أحد مجالسته، ومن رسمه في صحيفة من رصاص في شرف زحل وذكر الاسم عدده وقال:

اللهم اقبض على فلان قلبه وسره استجيب له، وهو من أذكار عزرائيل عليه السلام وفيه سر قبض

الأرواح، وله مربع جليل القدر وقد جمع بين مربعه الحرفي ومثله العددي، ومن أراد قبض روح

أحد فليتخذه ذكراً دائماً ويذكر اسم من أراد هلاكه فإنه يهلك فاتق الله، ومن أكثر من ذكره

أقبلت عليه عوالمه ويرى آثار انفعالات في نفسه وفي غيره بقدر اجتهاده وصفاء باطنه، وهذه صورته:

the حكم, and among his sciences was the science of letters, and from this his name was with him, and this is the community of Jesus because of what knowledge it indicates, and the ʿayn and the yāʾ are from the gentleness of the revelation, and the sīn from the comprehensive excellences of preference, and the alif from encompassing, and its kāf is from the number 150, and that is the most general knowledge; and since it was from the knowledge of the hidden matters of the affair, and it was said concerning it “ʿAlīm,” indicating that, it is written with his name “ʿAlīm,” so its number became 141, and as for the names of its letters, 292, they indicate “Baṣīr”; and since the world is a manifest sign for the sought one, connected to him with a complete connection, and it may be said [to be] the obtaining of an ʿayn connected with the completion of the meaning, and for this reason he observed the one who said: it is the obtaining of the form of the thing in the mind, so the meaning of al-ʿAliyy, in any case, is that for whom the ʿayn of a thing has become manifest, a manifestation connected to the outward of every thing and its inward, and it is from the secrets in which exaggeration with al-walmā is not suitable because of the sciences in it except after the utmost of all existents; and one only exaggerates in it by one of two matters: either by intensification, so it is said ʿAllām, and it is for indicating the revelation of subtleties and the apprehension of realities, and “ʿAlīm” is not said except of one who knows subtleties, as he knows the great matters, and knows the hidden matters as he knows the manifest matters. He تعالى said: {AND ABOVE EVERY ONE POSSESSING KNOWLEDGE IS ONE MORE KNOWING} so the possessor of knowledge is one who knows the universals of affairs, and the world is one who knows the outward aspects of affairs, and the knowing one is one who knows the manifest matters of affairs and their hidden matters, and remember that it is pluralized over many of the scholars, so he said concerning particulars. He تعالى said: {AND ABOVE EVERY ONE POSSESSING KNOWLEDGE} for the superiority of scholars over one another is not by the abundance of information, since if it were so, he would not have said to his prophet Moses عليه السلام to worship at the meeting-place of the two seas, one called al-Khiḍr, and he is more knowing than you; and al-Khiḍr عليه السلام was not more knowing than Moses in the sense that he had more information—how could he not, when Allah تعالى said concerning Moses: {AND WE WROTE FOR HIM IN THE TABLETS OF EVERYTHING AN ADMONITION AND A DETAILED EXPLANATION OF EVERYTHING}? Rather, what is meant is that he knows the inward aspects of his known things as he knows their outward aspects; and therefore his place was the meeting-place of the two seas, which are the sea of the outward and the inward, and he acknowledged to Moses that he was upon knowledge from the knowledge of Allah that he did not know. So strive, O you who stand upon these words, to be a scholar, a great scholar, and this is the meaning that Allah commanded His prophet to seek in His saying: {AND SAY: MY LORD, INCREASE ME IN KNOWLEDGE}; and the فضل of knowledge is famous, so reflect upon the meaning, and Allah is the One who grants success.

(Chapter twenty-one on His تعالى name Qābiḍ) Whoever ذكر this name, majesty and awe prevail over him, and no one is able to keep his company; and whoever draws it on a sheet of lead in the exaltation of Saturn and mentions the number of the name and says: “O Allah, seize the heart and secret of so-and-so,” it is answered for him. It is among the remembrances of ʿAzrāʾīl عليه السلام, and in it is the secret of seizing souls. It has a square of great value, and its letter-square has been joined with its numerical equivalent. Whoever desires to seize the soul of someone, let him take it as a constant remembrance and mention the name of the one he desires to destroy, for he will be destroyed—so fear Allah. Whoever increases in mentioning it, his worlds turn toward him, and he sees آثار of reactions in himself and in others according to his striving and the purity of his inward. And this is its form:

ناقص أجزاؤه ٥٠٥ يشير إلى اسمه راشد ومن هنا استروح من استروح أن قبض المال علامة

الرشد كما قال تعالى فإن آنستم منهم رشداً فادفعوا إليهم أموالهم وأما أسماء حروفه فهي ١١٠ تشير

إلى اسمه مغني وقال أولو الأسرار يرفع القرآن عند تمام حروفه ١٢٢ ويبقى بعد الألف ٢٠٠

سنة يذهب الله فيها الأمثل فالأمثل حتى لا يبقى على وجه الأرض من يعرف الله وقال أرباب الأنوار

فإذا وصل الزمان إلى عدد هذا الاسم ظهرت الآيات التي تدل على قيام الساعة وقال أرباب

الاطلاع الباقي إلى وصول قيام الساعة هو هذا القدر من السنين وهو بقاء الملة الإسلامية

( الفصل الثاني والعشرون في اسمه تعالى باسط ) لا يذكره خائف إلا أمن ولا حزين إلا سر ومن

نقشه على خاتم في الساعة الأولى من يوم الجمعة وحمله كثر فرحه وسروره وأحبه كل من رآه وإذا

تلاه صاحب حالة بسط الله رزقه وأحيا قلبه بالمعارف وهو من أذكار إسرافيل وبه ظهر سر

الإحياء كما بالقابض ظهر سر الإماتة ويصلح ذكر لمن اسمه محمود ومن داوم على ذكره سهلت

روحه وبسط عليه الرزق ومن داوم عليه إلى أن يغلب حال إجابته عوالمه الأخرى أنه يشير إلى

اسمه تعالى قريب وله من العدد ٧٢ فالاثنان تشير إلى السبعة والسبعين تشير إلى عين الشيء وقوته

من معنى التفضيل الذي يقتضيه السين فلذلك كانت الألف منه ومن قبضه أخافه وأما أسماء حروفه

٢٤٩ فتشير إلى اسمه الظاهر يوضع في مثلث عددي محيط به مربع حرفي وهذه صورته كآترى

على الفاجر وقطع دابر الظالم يقرأ عدده مضر وباقي اسم الظالم في

وأما أسماء حروفه ١٥٩٩ فتشير إلى اسمين وهما مغيث ماجد وهذه

صورته

(Chapter twenty-two on His تعالى name Bāsiṭ) No fearful one mentions it except that he becomes secure, and no sorrowful one except that he rejoices. Whoever engraves it on a ring in the first hour of Friday and carries it, his joy and gladness increase, and everyone who sees him loves him. And if the one of a state recites it, Allah expands his provision and revives his heart with knowledges. It is among the remembrances of Isrāfīl, and by it the secret of giving life appeared, just as by al-Qābiḍ the secret of causing death appeared. It is suitable as a remembrance for one whose name is Maḥmūd. Whoever persists in mentioning it, his soul becomes easy, and provision is expanded for him. Whoever persists upon it until the state of his other worlds overcomes the state of his response, it indicates His تعالى name Qarīb. It has from the number 72; the two indicates the seven, and the seventy-two indicates the very essence of the thing and its power from the meaning of preference which the sīn necessitates; therefore the alif is from it, and whoever seizes it frightens him. And as for the names of its letters, 249, they indicate His name al-Ẓāhir. It is placed in a numerical triangle surrounded by a letter-square, and this is its form as you see.

(Chapter twenty-three on His تعالى name Khāfiḍ) It is suitable for supplication against the wicked and for cutting off the tail of the الظالم. Its number is read as Muḍar, and the remainder of the name of the الظالم in the depth of the night, his destruction is obtained. It has from the number 1481, and it is a prime number. And as for the names of its letters, 1599, they indicate two names, and they are Mughīth, Mājid. And this is its form.

(Chapter twenty-four on His تعالى name Rāfiʿ) Whoever increases in mentioning it, Allah opens for him the raising of his rank and his remembrance, and if he is a man of conduct and characterizes himself by it, justice is inspired to him in his movements and his stillnesses. It has from the number 1251, and it is a stretched composite, deficient; its parts indicate Muqsiṭ. And as for the names of its letters, they are 45, indicating two gentle remembrances, and they are Mālik al-Mulk, Qarīb. And this is the form of its square.

(Chapter twenty-five on His تعالى name Muʿizz) This name—no one who persists in mentioning it while abased except that he becomes mighty, and no hidden one except that he becomes manifest. It is for strength and assistance in getting rid of the coverings of nature. Whoever engraves it in a square and carries it is awe-inspiring among people, and every tyrannical, obstinate one is terrified by it. It is among the greatest remembrances of the believers. It has from the number 124, and it is the even of the even and the odd; its deficient parts indicate a letter from the letters of encompassing, and it is 10, and it يدل upon length and strength and encompassing, and it is the qāf. And from the noble names to two majestic names, and they are Malik Majīd, and he is not able

(Chapter twenty-six on His تعالى name Mudhill) This name, of exalted شأن—whoever increases in mentioning it, Allah abases for him whatever He wills of his enemies. And it is fitting that everyone for whom a beast or one of creation has become difficult should mention it; let him increase in mentioning it, for Allah تعالى will abase him for him. Whoever takes it as a remembrance after fasting three days, the last of them Friday, and refrains on Friday from breaking the fast, and prays two rakʿahs, and mentions the name one hundred times after al-Fātiḥah, and when he prostrates does likewise, and in the second rakʿah likewise, and he gives salām and mentions the name after the salām one thousand times and says: “O Mudhill, abase so-and-so for me,” then he will be abased for him and will not مخالفة him in any matter of the matters. (A subtle point) When the people of inner sight witnessed with the fingers of their hearts the dāl of abasement, its place being the lām of gentleness and connection, they knew that there is no connection to Him except by abasement, so they equaled the dogs in eating from the refuse heaps, and the might that has no interruption was completed for them, and they were delivered from the predicament of abasement to other than Him until they knew by faith and witnessed beneficence and knew that there is no abaser except Allah. And it has from the number 707, and it is the even of the even from it to the odd in b, حاصل from the multiplication of a stretched [figure] in a place, and its parts 1096 indicate the exaltation of the wāw, and by the ninety the ṣamadāniyyah of the ṣād, and by the alif to the utmost of the ghayn. And since the first is attained in it from his care for the person, this number indicated these letters: m g n w. So the ghayn and the mīm and the nūn are concealed from his name, and the yāʾ was omitted because of what is in it of descent, for whoever descends for someone is abased, and the wāw became a substitute for the yāʾ, indicating wealth, in which is among its concomitants abasement. And as for the names of its letters, they are 893, indicating two majestic names, and they are Dhū al-Quwwah, Mājid. And as for its square, it is this.

(Chapter twenty-seven on His تعالى name Samīʿ) This name is suitable as a remembrance; every supplication, the supplication is answered. Whoever increases in mentioning it, no invocation of his is rejected. Whoever engraves it on a ring in the exaltation of the moon and increases in mentioning it, his speech is heard. It is suitable as a remembrance for preachers and admonishers, and for one whose name is Masʿūd. It has from the number 180, and it is the even of the even and the odd plus; its parts 200 indicate two majestic names, and they are Qābil, Mulhim, because the name of the Samīʿ corresponds to the Qābil, and since the name of the Samīʿ is a manifestation of the name of the Qābil, his dominion was fulfilled. ( الفصل الثامن والعشرون في اسمه تعالى بصير ) هذا الاسم الجليل القدر من

أكثر من ذكره بصره الله تعالى بالأمور الخفية فإن كان صاحب حالة صادقة

لم يخف عليه شيء من أمر دينه ودنياه وهذا الاسم له من العدد ٣٠٢ وهو زوج

فرد مستطيل يشير بالاثنين إلى السبت وبالثلاثمائة المائتين فهو سيد لذلك وأجزاؤه

١٥٤ تشير إلى اسمه قديم بكونه تعالى بصيرا بذلك قبل وجود الصور وأما ربعه فعلى هذه الصفة

( الفصل التاسع والعشرون في اسمه تعالى حكم ) هذا الاسم الجليل الشأن

من أكثر من ذكره نفذت كلمته ويصلح ذكرا للحكام والولاة وهو من

الأسرار المخزونة وله من العدد ٦٨ وهو زوج الزوج والفرد وله من

الأعداد الناقصة أجزاؤه ٥٨ تشير إلى اسمه أزلي وإلى اسمه تعالى مُنْعِم

وإلى اسمه صدوق فإن ذلك كله من مقتضى العدد وأسماء حروفه فلها من العدد ٣ من وجه

ومن وجه ١٨ فالأول تشير إلى اسمه عاصم وإلى اسمه فاضل وهذه الأسماء الثلاثة إطار اعتبارا

من الثلاثة الأول وهذه صورته

( الفصل الثلاثون في اسمه تعالى عدل ) هذا الاسم الفاخر والسر الظاهر من دعا

به على ظالم أخذ قوته وإذا أكثر من ذكره كما ألهمه الله تعالى العدل في رعيته

ويصلح ذكرا لمن كان اسمه عبد المؤمن وله من العدد ١٠٤ فأما الأربعة فللدلالة

على الدوام واتساع الملك وانضاقت الممالك وقصرت الدول لكثرة الجور وهذا العدد من أعداد

زوج الزوج والفرد الزائد أجزاؤه ١٠٦ تشير إلى اسمه منجي وإلى اسمه وفي فمن وفي فقد عدل

في رعيته ونجى نفسه من الذم ورعيته من الجور قال تعالى يا داود إنا جعلناك خليفة في الأرض فاحكم

بين الناس بالحق ولا تتبع الهوى فيضلك عن سبيل الله ( نكتة ) لما طرح لعمر رضي الله عنه وسادة

قال عمر هذا هو أول الجور أراد عمر أن من كان حكما لا ينبغي له تفضيل أحد على أحد بما يلائم

هواه وغرضه وقال إن الناس إذا لم يكونوا سواء يكون جورا وهذا هو الخاتم

مرض ومن كان مقهورا تحت سلطان جائر أو سلطان طبعه من أكثر ذكره خلص

من ذلك ويذكر به من كان اسمه صالح وله من العدد ١٢٩ وهو عدد فرد مستطيل بعده الثلاث

وثلاث وأربعين وهو ناقص أجزاؤه ٤٧ تشير إلى الوالي لما في اللطف من الولاية إلى اسم مبدئ لما

فيه من الرجوع إلى حكم الفطرة ومن ثم عدده الأول بثلاث * وأما أسماء حروفه فتشير إلى اسمه مقبل

(Chapter twenty-eight on His, تعالى, name Basir) This noble name, whoever increases in mentioning it, Allah, تعالى, makes him perceive the hidden matters. If he is a possessor of a true state, nothing of the affair of his religion and his الدنيا will be hidden from him. And this name has, from the number, 302, and it is even odd elongated, indicating by the two to Saturday and by the three hundred the two hundred, so he is its master. And its parts, 154, indicate His name Qadim by His, تعالى, being seeing of that before the existence of forms. As for its quarter, it is upon this form.

(Chapter twenty-nine on His, تعالى, name Hakam) This name, great in شأن, whoever increases in mentioning it, his word is effective, and it is suitable as a ذكر for judges and governors, and it is from the hidden secrets. And it has from the number 68, and it is even-even and odd, and it has from the deficient numbers. Its parts, 58, indicate His name Azali and to His, تعالى, name Mun'im and to His name Saduq, for all that is from the مقتضى of the number and the names of its letters. So for them there is from the number 3 from one aspect and from an aspect 18, so the first indicate His name Asim and to His name Fadil, and these three names are an إطار, as consideration, from the first three. And this is its form.

(Chapter thirty on His, تعالى, name Adl) This splendid name and the manifest secret: whoever calls upon it against an oppressor, his strength is taken. And if he increases in mentioning it, as Allah, تعالى, inspires him, justice in his subjects. And it is suitable as a ذكر for whoever’s name is Abd al-Mu'min. And it has from the number 104. As for the four, it is for indicating permanence and the expansion of kingship, and the kingdoms have narrowed and the states have shortened because of the abundance of injustice. And this number is from the numbers of even-even and odd, the زائد; its parts, 106, indicate His name Munji and to His name وفي فمن وفي فقد عدل in his subjects, and saved himself from blame and his subjects from injustice. He, تعالى, said: “O David, We have made you a vicegerent in the earth, so judge between the people with truth and do not follow desire, lest it lead you astray from the path of Allah.” (Note) When a cushion was thrown to ʿUmar, رضي الله عنه, ʿUmar said: “This is the first injustice.” ʿUmar intended that whoever is a judge should not prefer one over another by what suits his desire and purpose. And he said that if people are not equal, it is injustice. And this is the seal.

(Chapter thirty-one on His, تعالى, name Latif) This name is quick in response for relieving distress at times of hardships, and it is suitable as a ذكر for prisoners and captives and whoever is afflicted by severe illness and whoever is subjugated under an unjust سلطان or the سلطان of his nature. Whoever increases in mentioning it is delivered from that. And it is mentioned by it for whoever’s name is Salih. And it has from the number 129, and it is an odd elongated number after it the three and forty-three, and it is deficient. Its parts, 47, indicate the governor, because in لطف there is ولاية, to the name Mubdi' because in it there is return to the حكم of the fitrah; and from this its first number is by three. * As for the names of its letters, they indicate His name Muqbil.

۞ And know that this name has noble properties in relieving distress at times of hardships, and nothing else is added to it; wonder appears from its effects. And whoever takes charge of it does not mention it with anything in himself or his body, there remains not in its midst Allah repeated. And no one mentions it in himself a great matter except that the like of that matter is represented for him in his seclusion, and the one remembering turns toward it while observing that quality or witnessing it, how it becomes manifest and vanishes, so he does not rise from his station and there remains something that frightens him. And in that are wondrous secrets, and Allah is the One who grants success.

(Chapter thirty-two on His, تعالى, name Khabir)

This name is suitable as a ذكر for whoever desires اطلاع upon a hidden matter in his sleep or his waking, and whoever places it in a square in the exaltation of Mercury and places it under his head will become aware of hidden matters. And whoever mentions it for 7 days in seclusion and spiritual exercise, the Ruhaniyyah comes to him with every خبر he desires, from the أخبار of the year or from the أخبار of kings. And its number is 838, and it is even odd زائد. Its parts, 268, indicate two noble names, and they are Khaliq and Wasiʿ, for none informs of things upon their reality except one who has expanded them in knowledge and originated them in creation. Does He not know who خلق, and He is the لطيف, the خبير? As for the names of its letters, they are 209, indicating two noble names, and they are Akhir and Wahid. And this is the description of its square.

(Chapter thirty-three on His, تعالى, name Halim)

Whoever mentions this name in the presence of a tyrant at the time of his anger, he becomes calm. And whoever places it in the exaltation of the moon in a square and keeps it with him, his character becomes good, his soul becomes pleasant, people desire him, and he is secure from compulsion and disturbance when hardships descend. And it is from the noble names; none knows its value except the knowers. And it has from the number 88, and it is even-even and odd زائد. Its parts, 93, indicate His, تعالى, name Aman. And this name is from the most special names of our master Muhammad, عليه السلام; therefore his supplication was: “O Allah, forgive my people, for they do not know.” And therefore his name, its number, is a talisman indicating this name. As for the names of its letters, 183, they indicate his name Majid by one consideration and to his name Mata by one consideration. And this is its square.

(Chapter thirty-four on His, تعالى, name ʿAzim) This red sulfur and the greatest magnet: whoever persists in mentioning it, Allah gives him enduring might, and he becomes great in the eyes of people and his faults are concealed from them. If its possessor is in a true state and complete turning, he witnesses the command of Allah, تعالى, for the universes, and witnesses the secrets in every seclusion. And whoever persists in mentioning it, Allah gives him enduring might, and everyone who sees him loves him and he becomes great in the eyes of people. And it has from the number 1020, and it is even-even, increased according to what greatness requires from the nine. Its parts, 191, increase over the الأصل and ع غ. So the waw is for loftiness, that is, the collectives of the preference of existence, and the ʿayn is an indication of concealment; so glory be to the One who is hidden by the intensity of His manifestation. And the ghayn is the name Ghani and the light of light, and for the ya' to descend upon the manifestation of the ghayn and the consideration of the numbers of the rest of this name and the exits of its parts, as comes out from the limit of abbreviation, but there has been obtained from the similitude that in it is sufficiency for whoever casts the hearing while he is a witness. As for the names of its letters, they are 331, indicating two noble names, and they are Ghalib, Maniḥ. As for its square, it is upon this form.

(Chapter thirty-five on His, تعالى, name Ghafur)

Whoever increases in mentioning it, Allah saves him from what he fears and warns against. And it is a secret in calming the anger of kings, and it is suitable for whoever is in the service of the sultans, and it is suitable as a ذكر for whoever is overcome by sorrow or was among the wayfarers. And it has from the number 1286, and it is even odd deficient. Its parts, 339, indicate His name 536, for He, تعالى, is odd and His oddities are even. And it is from the names whose numbers are deficient by their letters. As for the names of its letters, they are 132, indicating two noble names, and they are Dhu al-ʿArsh, Majid. As for its square, it is upon this form.

(Chapter thirty-six on His, تعالى, name Shakur)

Whoever increases in mentioning it, the truth thanks His, تعالى, acts, and it is a help for him toward what he wants of acts of الخير, and by it the blessings are established and its stray ones are returned. And in it are secrets for the people of unveilings, which they witness when they تحقق by it. And it has from the number 526; so the six indicates loftiness, and the twenty to what has appeared from the high place, and the five hundred indicates مرة 500, so it is the utmost of the ranks of manifestation. And it is even odd elongated; its parts, 666, indicate His, تعالى, name Niʿm al-Dayyan. And in it is an indication of the nurturing of the breast, just as one of us nurtures his colt and his foal. As for the names of its letters, they are 65, indicating two noble names, and they are Sattar, Jawad. As for its square, it is upon this form.

(Chapter thirty-seven on His, تعالى, name ʿAli)

Whoever increases in mentioning this name, Allah ennobles his face from humbling himself to others, and everyone who sees him loves him, and Allah supports him with His victory, and releases him with wisdom, and [teaches] the subtleties of the sciences. And whoever increases in mentioning it, Allah raises his rank and elevates him, and everyone who sees him loves him.

And every one who called him was led to him, and he saw in his age the shining exaltation, and in himself the dazzling loftiness, and in him a wondrous secret for the shaykhs and the great ones and the seekers of the sciences and the lights. And if his name, al-‘Alim, is added to it, it is among the greatest remembrances, and among the most successful of them. Whoever is successful in it, in a ring of gold, and perfumes it with oud, and carries it with him, then everyone who sees him submits to him. And the kings used to take it, from al-Saffah until our time, may God establish their kingship. And al-Ma’mun was asked: how are you, when the kings of Persia have come to you? So he brought out his hand with a ring in which the two names were set upright and said: no one is able against us so long as this is with us. And the fitting time for it is the honor of the moon, and this is its form.

He تعالى said: “And God is encompassing over them” etc. And since its manifestation in everything is existence, and its veiling when it is raised is by the requirement of His wisdom, necessarily the number indicates its exclusiveness. And God has described with wisdom what He described with loftiness. He تعالى said: “And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, surely exalted, wise.” And it is among the numbers of the even and the odd, and the sum of its parts is 42, increasing upon it by its like, and it is as though it says: ‘Ali or higher, He is the Wise. Whoever increases in mentioning it, every thing becomes small in his sight, and no one sees him except that he fears him. And it is among the majestic remembrances that are mentioned with kings and tyrants, so their souls become small before him in certainty. And it has from the number 333, and it is the even of the odd, minus its parts, 262 digits. And the names of its letters indicate two majestic names, and they are Basir, One. (Chapter Thirty-Nine on His تعالى name, Hafiz)

Whoever increases in mentioning it in his travel, God preserves him until his return from it. And whoever draws it in a page in the honor of Jupiter, it is not placed in anything except that God preserves it. And whoever increases in mentioning it is محفوظ from every disliked thing. And it is the square of response for the fearful in travels, for whoever remembers it is secure in his homeland from fear and sees no disliked thing. And it has been timed in the places of dread and seizure, so I turned to its ذكر and saw from the wonders of God’s making what no one reaches. And whoever engraves it on the bezel of a silver ring and makes its number according to the breaking of letters in the interior of the ring and carries it, then he is in the midst of beasts and no harm reaches him. And he says after it: “O Hafiz, preserve me” 3 times; the sought thing is obtained. And this is its form, literally and numerically.

of his safety. And a group passed by a man standing in a lion-infested place, his horse grazing around him, so they left him and said to him: do you not fear while you are
in this place and there are beasts in it? So he raised his head and said: I am ashamed before Him to fear other than Him. And whoever is realized by this name,
then God preserves him in all his times and movements, as was related from Abu al-Daqa’iq that he said: ten
thousand dinars came to one of the righteous, so he said: My God, I am in need of them, and if I do not know how to preserve them, then deposit them with You and return them to me
at the time of my need for them, and give charity with them to the poor and the needy.
So whenever he needed something he asked God and He gave him what he asked until
He gave him many times their like. And God is the Giver. And some of those informed
about the secrets of letters and the effects of conditions placed it in this form
as you see, so understand, you will be guided.

( Chapter forty-six in His تعالى name Wāsi‘ )

This noble name and the subtle secret: whoever increases in ذكره, Allah expands for him his provision

and his creation and his knowledge, and makes ample for him his term. And it is among the noble names, and its bearer does not obtain constriction; rather he finds expansiveness, and Allah makes

for him in his affair relief and an outlet. Whoever persists upon this جامع, radiant name and the lofty, dazzling secret, Allah تعالى expands

for him his provision and expands his breast. Whoever breaks it in a 4×4 square in the increase of the moon and remembers its number after reciting

al-Fātiḥa and carries it with him, Allah makes the difficult matters easy and makes provision easy for him. In it is a wondrous secret for kings, princes, and notables.

And every king who increases in its ذكر, his kingdom expands and his word spreads. And it has the number 137: the seven for getting out of constriction,

and the thirty for the arrangement of all the names in Wāsi‘ and its connection, and the hundred for its encompassing and its manifestation. Therefore the number was جامعًا

for the first of the names in manifestation and the one descending in appearance, which in truth is the last of them in manifestation, and that is because it is Malik. And this number, if

its like is carried upon it, that is more expansive, and ذات is an indication of Muḥammad, صلى الله عليه وسلم, and he is the one indicated by His saying, “My believing servant’s heart has expanded me.”

And this is from the prime numbers. It was only so because the outward wording, when it necessitated

the ظرفية for every thing such that its manifestation would be an obstacle between the manifestation of every thing, then the joining was more deserving of this meaning than

the splitting, and He تعالى is sanctified from that a thing should dwell in Him or that a thing should dwell in it. Rather, it is a noble indication understood by subtle

tastes. (Nukta) Whoever witnesses the عظَمة said: I saw nothing except that I saw Allah before it. And the eye is the inward of the عظَمة, and it is

the outward of expansiveness; therefore the عظَمة was an izār, so understand that, for it is among the subtleties of tawḥīd. As for the names | ع | س |

of its letters, 137, they indicate His name, that spirit, because of the vastness of its encompassing. And this is the form of its square as you see | 66 | 52 | 5

a body suitable to it, carrying it with him, remembering the name, characterizing himself with the character of the wise, and comporting himself with their manners, the divine effusion is doubled upon him,

هو إفراد المحبة وود الشفقة وهو استفراغ الإرادة في المحبوب والتعلق به والله الموفق

( الفصل التاسع والأربعون في اسمه تعالى مجيد )

هذا الاسم العظيم الشأن الجليل البرهان يصلح ذكراً للملوك لأنهم إذا داوموا عليه اتسع ملكهم

ويصلح أيضاً للأقطاب والمستخلفين ومن ذكره على أن يغلب عليه منه حال لا ترد كلمته ويصلح

ذكراً لمن اسمه عبد المجيد ومن واظب على ذكره وكان صاحب حالة صادقة سهل الله عليه

الأمور وأحيا روحه بالمعارف وقوى باطنه بلطائف الأسرار وفيه سر عظيم لإظهار الخبايا والكنوز

والعثور على خفايا الرموز وله من العدد ٥٧ فالسبعة إشارة إلى أنه من تخلص من تبعات الملك ولا

يتخلص من ذلك إلا من كان فعالاً لما يريد وليس ذلك إلا الله تعالى والخمسون إشارة إلى أنه من كان

بيده مدار كل شيء وذلك أيضاً مما يخفيه سبحانه وتعالى وهو فرد ناقص مستطيل أجزاؤه ٣١ تشير

إلى الألف الأولى والإقامة كاف الكلمة وأما أسماء حروفه فهي باعتبار ١٩٠ وباعتبار ١٨٨

فالاعتبار الأول تشير إلى اسمه تعالى هو الله الواحد واجب الوجود

وبالاعتبار الثاني تشير إلى اسمه مولى الكل وهذه صورته كآترى

( الفصل الخمسون في اسمه تعالى باعث )

هذا الاسم الأكبر والسر الأنور يصلح لمن ضعفت عزيمته عن أمر فمن

أكثر من ذكره انبعث إلى كل خير وقال بعضهم هو الاستيلاء للحياة والصحة على الأبدان وحفظ

القوى إذا أردت ذلك ادخل الخلوة وأقرأ الاسم على خلوة معدة وفراغ قلب إلى أن يحصل لك

منه حال فإن الله يمدك بالقوى وتقوى همتك على فعل الطاعة ومن نقش هذا الاسم في صحيفة من

رصاص في الأولى من يوم السبت ثم ذكره ٤٠١١ مرة وهو ينظر لشكلة ثم يقول يا باعث سلطتك

على كذا وكذا فإنه يكون ذلك وله من العدد ٥٧٢ فالعين والفاء فيه باقية على حالها واتخذ السبب

بالألف القيم الذي هو مسبب الأسباب وهذا العدد فرد ناقص أجزاؤه

تشير إلى اسمه صادق ومولى الموالي وهذه صورته

( الفصل الحادي والخمسون في اسمه تعالى شهيد )

من لازم على ذكره أمرت له المراقبة في خلواته وجلواته وإن كان

صاحب حالة صادقة تخلق له ذلك وانصاغت نفسه بصفة الوحدة والعزلة

فأمن من الإفراط والتفريط في كافة أخلاقه نفسه وهو من أجل الأذكار ويصلح لمن يطلب

مرتبة الشهادة وقد أمرت بعض الناس بذكره فحصلت لهم الشهادة ومن رسمه في الأولى من

يوم الجمعة في كاغد عدد قواه الظاهرة ووضعه على قلبه من غير حائل شهدت الأشباح

بجوده وفضله ونطقت الأفواه برشده ورزقه الله الهيبة والبهجة والوقار وله من العدد ٣١٢ وهو

عدد أول لأن معناه ما تضمنه من الوعيد رتق لا فتق فيه وكفى بالله شهيداً وأسماء حروفه ٣١٩

**English:**

It is the singling out of love and the affection of compassion, and it is the emptying of the will in the beloved and attachment to him; and Allah is the One who grants success.

(Chapter Forty-Nine on His, تعالى, Name Majid)

This name, of great شأن and sublime proof, is suitable as a remembrance for kings, because if they persist upon it their kingdom expands. It is also suitable for the poles and the successors, and for whoever remembers it such that a state from it prevails over him, his word is not repelled. It is suitable as a remembrance for one whose name is Abd al-Majid. Whoever persists in its remembrance and is a possessor of a true state, Allah makes the affairs easy for him, revives his spirit with knowledges, and strengthens his inward with the subtleties of secrets. In it is a great secret for the manifestation of hidden things and treasures and for finding the hidden things of symbols. Its number is 57. The seven is an indication that it is of one who is freed from the consequences of kingship, and none is freed from that except one who is active in what he wills, and that is none but Allah تعالى. And the fifty is an indication that it is of one in whose hand is the course of every thing, and that also is among what He, سبحانه وتعالى, conceals. And it is a single deficient elongated one; its parts, 31, indicate the first alif and the iqāmah, the kaf of the word. As for the names of its letters, they are by consideration 190 and by consideration 188. The first consideration indicates His, تعالى, name: He is Allah, the One, the Necessary Existent. And by the second consideration it indicates His name, Master of all. And this is its form as you see.

(Chapter Fifty on His, تعالى, Name Ba'ith)

This greatest name and the brightest secret is suitable for one whose resolve concerning a matter has weakened; whoever increases in its remembrance is impelled toward every good. Some of them said: it is the domination of life and health over bodies and the preservation of powers. If you desire that, enter seclusion and recite the name in an prepared seclusion and an emptied heart until a state from it occurs for you, for Allah extends to you powers and your aspiration is strengthened for the doing of obedience. Whoever inscribes this name in a tablet of lead in the first [hour/day] of Saturday, then remembers it 4011 times while looking at its shaklah, then says: O Ba'ith, I have empowered you over such-and-such, then that will be so. Its number is 572. The ayn and the fa in it remain upon their state. And take the means by the upright alif, which is the Causer of causes. And this number is a single deficient one; its parts indicate His name Sadiq and Master of masters. And this is its form.

(Chapter Fifty-One on His, تعالى, Name Shahid)

Whoever persists in its remembrance, watchfulness is commanded for him in his seclusions and his public states. And if he is a possessor of a true state, that is formed for him, and his soul is molded by the attribute of unity and isolation, so he is safe from excess and deficiency in all the qualities of his soul. It is among the noblest remembrances and is suitable for one who seeks the rank of martyrdom. I have commanded some people to remember it, and martyrdom occurred for them. Whoever draws it in the first [hour/day] of Friday on paper, the number of its outward powers, and places it upon his heart without any barrier, the forms testify to his generosity and فضل, and the mouths speak of his right guidance, and Allah grants him awe, joy, and dignity. Its number is 312, and it is a prime number because its meaning, what it contains of threat, is a sealing in which there is no opening. And sufficient is Allah as Witness. And the names of its letters are 319

تشير إلى اسمه مجرى الفلك لأن الفلك تجري بأمر الله كما في التنزيل وهذه صورته

( الفصل الثاني والخمسون في اسمه تعالى حق )

من أكثر من ذكره ثبته الله تعالى على الطاعات وأظهر له حقائق الأمور وأطلعه على خفيات الأسرار وأبغض إليه الباطل وجعل كلمته عالية قاهرة وبه يثبت الله الذين آمنوا ومن نقش مربعه والطالع أحد البروج الثابتة على آلة يريد ثبات شيء فيها ثبت الله ذلك الشيء ويكون بعد ذكر الاسم إلى أن يغلب عليه منه حال ويكتب حول المربع وأما ما ينفع الناس فيمكث في الأرض وله من العدد ١٠٠٨ رسماً فأما الأول فهو زوج الزوج والفرد زائد أجزاؤه ٤٣٢ تشير إلى اسم صبور صادق لما في الصاد من سر المطابقة في الجسم وأما الثاني فهو زوج الزوج أجزاؤه ١٧٢ تشير إلى اسمه مقبل وأما مربعه فعلى هذه الصفة

( الفصل الثالث والخمسون في اسمه تعالى وكيل )

من أكثر من ذكره كفاه الله وأغناه عن السبب ورزقه من حيث لا يحتسب وإن كان صاحب حالة صادقة أكمل السكون وصار يتصرف فيه ويصلح ذكراً لمن كان اسمه محمد وله من العدد ٦٦ وهو زوج فرد مستطيل وهو من الأسماء المختصة بمحمد عليه السلام فلذلك سماه الله في الكتب بالمتوكل ولجمعية هذا الاسم اختصاصه بالنبي عليه السلام فلذلك طابق الاسم الجامع عدداً فكان الله ٦٦ ووكيل كذلك ومجموع ذلك ١٣٢ اسمه عليه السلام محمد هذا العدد زائد على ما تقرر وأجزاؤه ٧٨ تشير إلى اسمه تعالى حكيم فإن الوكيل إذا لم يكن حكيماً لم يضع الأشياء في موضعها وقيل في ذلك شعر

إذا كنت في حاجة مرسلاً * فأرسل حكيماً ولا توصه

وله مثلث جليل القدر وهذه صورته كما ترى

وأجزاء كل من الاسمين تشير إلى أصله وذلك اسمه أحب وهو من أخص أسمائه عليه السلام ( تنبيه ) إذا اجتمع زيادة أحدهما إلى الآخر كان ذلك ٩٤ وهو اسمه عليه السلام وحبيبه كما كان مجموع كل منهما اسم أحب أو وكيل حب وأما أسماء حروفه فهي ١٩٨ تشير إلى اسمه تعالى القيوم لما في الوكالة من القيام بالشيء

indicate His name, the course of the sphere, because the spheres move by the command of Allah as in the revelation. And this is its form.

(Chapter Fifty-Two on His, تعالى, Name Haqq)

Whoever increases in its remembrance, Allah تعالى establishes him upon acts of obedience and shows him the realities of affairs and informs him of the hidden things of secrets and makes falsehood hateful to him and makes his word high, overpowering. And by it Allah establishes those who believe. Whoever inscribes its square, and the ascendant is one of the fixed signs, on an instrument, intending the stability of a thing therein, Allah establishes that thing. And it is after the remembrance of the name until a state from it prevails over him, and he writes around the square. As for what benefits people, it remains in the earth. Its number is 1008 in form. As for the first, it is the pair of the pair and the single, plus its parts 432, indicating the name Sabur Sadiq because of what is in the sad of the secret of correspondence in the body. As for the second, it is the pair of the pair; its parts 172 indicate His name Muqbil. As for its square, it is upon this description.

(Chapter Fifty-Three on His, تعالى, Name Wakil)

Whoever increases in its remembrance, Allah suffices him and enriches him from the means, and provides him from where he does not reckon. And if he is a possessor of a true state, the stillness is perfected and he begins to act within it. It is suitable as a remembrance for one whose name is Muhammad. Its number is 66, and it is a stretched even-single. It is among the names specific to Muhammad, عليه السلام; for that reason Allah named him in the books al-Mutawakkil. And because of the collectivity of this name, its specificity to the Prophet, عليه السلام, is established; for that reason the جامع name matched a number, so Allah was 66 and Wakil likewise, and the sum of that is 132. His name, عليه السلام, Muhammad—this number is in addition to what has been established. Its parts, 78, indicate His, تعالى, name Hakim, for the wakil, if he is not wise, does not place things in their place. And poetry was said regarding that:

If you are sent in need, then send a wise one and do not instruct him.

It has a triangle of noble value, and this is its form as you see.

And the parts of each of the two names indicate its origin, and that is his name Ahabb, and it is among the most specific of his names, عليه السلام. (Note) If the increase of one of them to the other is joined, that is 94, and it is his name, عليه السلام, and his beloved, just as the sum of each of them was the name Ahabb or Wakil, حب. As for the names of its letters, they are 198, indicating His, تعالى, name al-Qayyum, because in agency is the standing with the thing.

(Chapter Fifty-Four on His, تعالى, Name Qawi)

Whoever increases in its remembrance becomes strong in bearing the outward and inward burdens, and his spirit becomes strong. It is among the remembrances of Azra'il, عليه السلام, and is suitable as a remembrance for one who suffers bearing burdens, and is suitable as a remembrance for one whose name is Musa. And it should be added to it al-Mubdi'. Whoever persists in its remembrance will never tire in his journey. Its number is 126, and it is a stretched even-single plus its parts 920, indicating a noble remembrance: whoever attaches himself to it, nothing will disgrace him, and it is Allah 94. This is what its numbers make you understand in word. And if it is considered as a number, it is 116, and it is a stretched even-single deficient; its parts 29 indicate His, تعالى, name Aziz.

This name, of noble value: whoever increases in its remembrance is safe from weakness of strength and does not weaken 30 25 24 37 from a matter strong against him, even if he weakens. It should be remembered by one who fears the severing of his strength. If al-Qawi is added to it, it is at the utmost of speed of effect, especially one who suffers bearing burdens. Its number is 500, and it is the pair of the pair and the single, plus its parts 592, increasing over the الأصل by what is indicated by the name Aman. He تعالى said: “Indeed, the best one you have hired is the strong, the trustworthy.” And He تعالى said: “Indeed, We offered the trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, but they refused to bear it and feared it,” because although they had strength, they did not have firmness, and it is the trust from the severing of strength. Then He تعالى said: “And man bore it; indeed he was unjust to himself,” by his ignorance of what he has no strength to bear, ignorant of strength because of lack of firmness. عليه وسلم أول ما خلق الله تعالى نوري، فهو صلى الله عليه وسلم كله حمد، فتح الله له بكتاب الوجود،

فإنه أمر ذو بال، فلو لم يبدأ في محمد الله الذي هو محمد خلقه وأحمد هم لكان أجذم، ولذلك كانت دعوى

النبيين دعوته بنص، وآخر دعواهم أن الحمد لله رب العالمين، فهو صلى الله عليه وسلم الفاتح الخاتم، كما افتتح

به الحق تعالى كتاب الابداء، فكذلك يفتتح به كتاب الاعادة، كما قال صلى الله عليه وسلم: أنا أول من

تنشق الأرض عنه، ولذلك خص صلى الله عليه وسلم بسورة الحمد التي هي فاتحة كتاب كنز تحت

العرش، لم يفتح الاسم صلى الله عليه وسلم هذه الأذواق النورانية تفز بحظ وافر من المواهب

اللدنية، وهذا له من العدد ٦٣، وهو زوج فرد زائد أجزاؤه ٣٤ تشير إلى قولك هو طيب، وأما أسماء

حروفه ١٣٠ فتشير إلى اسمه آخر مهيمن والجامع، وأما مربعه فعلى هذه الصفة:

( الفصل الثامن والخمسون في اسمه تعالى محصى )

هذا الاسم الفخيم الجليل البرهان، من أكثر من ذكره أورثه الله تعالى المراقبة،

ويصلح ذكراً لمن يصلح له الحصيب، وله من العدد ١٤٨، فالثمانية للكمال،

والأربعون للمائة للإحاطة، والمحصى من له كمال تام محيط، وهذا العدد زوج الزوج والفرد

ناقص أجزاؤه ١١٨ تشير إلى اسمه تعالى حي عند أهل الأسرار، وملك عند أهل الأنوار، وذلك لما

تقضى الحياة من الملك، والكمال من الإحاطة به. تنبيه: اعلم أن جميع ما تقدم من الأسماء من اسمه الرحيم

إلى اسمه الحمد أعلامها إنما يتعلق بمعنى الأسباب كالوهاب والكريم والرزاق وأمثالها كالعليم

والحكيم والسميع والبصير وشبهها، وقد حصل خاتمتها الحمد، وما انتظم لها من اسمه المحصى إلى اسمه

الصبور فعامتها موجودة للعبد، فما يأتي ذلك في المحصى والمبدئ وغيره إن شاء الله

تعالى إلى الصبور، وفي وحدة المعرفة ظهرت في اسمه الهادي، وأما أسماء حروفه ٥٠ فتشير إلى اسمين

جليلين وهما عزيز كافي، وأما مربعه فهو هذا:

( الفصل التاسع والخمسون في اسمه تعالى مبدئ )

هذا الاسم النوراني والسر الرباني، من أكثر من ذكره بدت له خفيات الأمور،

وأنفقه الله تعالى بالحكمة، ولا يبدوه منه لأحد إلا ما يحب من الأسماء الجليلة،

لمن أراد إنجاز أمره في علم الكون، ولمن ابتدأ في أمر وذكره كان تاماً مباركاً لكل ما ابتدأ فيه،

ويصلح ذكراً لمن يريد الابتداء في تأليف العلوم السنية والأشعار النحوية، وله من العدد ٥٦، وهو

من الولي بمنزلة الوكيل من اسمه تعالى الله، ولذلك اجتمع بينهما اسمه تعالى مبين، وبالولاية والابتداء

الذي هو الإظهار تبين كل شيء، وأما أسماء حروفه ٢٠٥ تشير إلى اسمه تعالى عالم، وأما مربعه

upon him be peace and blessings, the first thing God تعالى created was my light; so he, صلى الله عليه وسلم, is all praise. God opened for him with the Book of existence, for it is a matter of great importance. For if it had not begun in Muhammad of God, who is Muhammad, His creation, and Ahmad, they, it would have been maimed; and therefore the claim of the prophets was his claim by text, and the last of their claims is: “Praise be to God, Lord of the worlds.” So he, صلى الله عليه وسلم, is the opener, the sealer, just as the Truth تعالى opened with him the Book of origination, likewise with him is opened the Book of return, as he, صلى الله عليه وسلم, said: “I am the first for whom the earth will split open.” Therefore he, صلى الله عليه وسلم, was singled out with Sūrat al-Ḥamd, which is the opening of the Book of a treasure beneath the Throne. The name صلى الله عليه وسلم did not open these luminous tastes; you will attain a plentiful share of the divine gifts. (Chapter Fifty-Eight on His تعالى name Muḥṣī)

This majestic, sublime, demonstrative name: whoever mentions it much, God تعالى bequeaths to him watchfulness. It is suitable as a remembrance for one for whom al-ḥaṣīb is suitable. And this number is even-even and odd, whose parts are 118, indicating His تعالى name Ḥayy among the people of secrets, and Malik among the people of lights, and that is because life is completed by kingship, and perfection by encompassing it. Note: know that all the names mentioned above, from His name al-Raḥīm to His name al-Ḥamd, their designations are only connected to the meaning of causes, such as al-Wahhāb, al-Karīm, al-Razzāq, and their like, such as al-ʿAlīm, al-Ḥakīm, al-Samīʿ, al-Baṣīr, and the like of them; and their conclusion has been attained by al-Ḥamd. This lofty name and manifest secret: whoever mentions it much until his worlds agree with him and a state from it prevails over him, then his remaining in the world increases, and God تعالى fills his heart with the light of monotheism. It is among the remembrances of Gabriel عليه السلام, and it is suitable as a remembrance for one whose name is Idrīs. — 185 —

if it were not like the thousand, there would be no life; and if something were deficient from it, there would be death in it according to the amount of its deficiency. Therefore twenty-eight was from the multiplication of the first perfect square number, for this number is the number of the letters, which are the perfection of existence, the number of the appointed stations in the greatest sphere, which are the descent of the divine command in the position of the exits of letters. And the secrets of this number are many; they do not befit this abridgment. In sum, the Living, the Living, is not judged by this in respect of its utterance. As for in respect of its numeral value, it is composed of two letters, ḥ y, and it is even-odd plus whose parts are 18, and it is a composite odd number in the first perfect. So whatever was multiplied by the encompassing of dāl became inverted in the encompassing of jīm, and the number decreases by seven, and they are the realities of the letters by which the world is attained, by which is the life of the age, which is the reversal of the Truth, so the following: “And whomsoever We grant long life, We reverse him in creation. Will they not then reason?” Therefore the Fātiḥah was named from these letters, and it was twenty-one letters; reflect on that. As for the names of its letters, they are 19, indicating His تعالى name Hādī. As for its square, it is upon this form as you see:

(Chapter Sixty-Four on His تعالى name Qayyūm)

This radiant name and noble, dazzling secret: whoever mentions it much, God تعالى establishes his affair outwardly and inwardly. If he is a possessor of a true state, God establishes by him everything. It is suitable as a remembrance for one whose name is Yūsuf, and in that is a verification that is not hidden. * And know that qayyūmiyyah is خاص to Him تعالى, for He تعالى is قائم over every soul for what it has earned, and God is encompassing behind them, the verse, and He is with you wherever you are, and God is Seeing of what you do, Lord of the two Easts and Lord of the two Wests; so wherever you turn, there is the Face of God. Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you are only pledging allegiance to God; the hand of God is فوق their hands. Did they not know that God is He who accepts repentance from His servants? And you did not throw when you threw, but God threw. Charity falls into the palm of the Merciful. “He was ill and did not visit me,” and the ḥadīth: “I was his hearing and his sight.” And His تعالى name al-Qayyūm is a plain encompassing of His monotheism by every name of His names, outward from creation and inward from command, and a barzakh between them: “God, there is no god but He, the Living, the Qayyūm.” And We created not the heavens and the earth and what is between them. So the name of God تعالى was not exceeded by other than Him, because of what the Creator sees of His monotheism; likewise the name al-Qayyūm, and it is among what God has restricted tongues from, so none other than Him is named by it. * And know that the greatest name of God تعالى is in these two verses: “And your God is one God; there is no god but He, the Merciful, the Compassionate,” “God, there is no god but He, the Living, the Qayyūm,” as has come in the report. And the greatest name of God is that which, if it is invoked, its names vanish by its qayyūmiyyah. * “Lo, everything except God is false.” * And the living die in every state. “Everyone upon it is perishing, and there remains the Face of your Lord, Possessor of Majesty and Honor. You are dying, and they are dying.” And everything perishes: “There is no god but God” in His majesty. And there is none of the god except those whom you call upon besides God; they will not create a fly, even if they gathered for it. And it has from the number 667, and it is even-odd deficient whose parts are 176, indicating His name Muʾammal and His name Badīʿ, for the value of every thing in truth is only wondrous, as He تعالى said: “Originator of the heavens and the earth.” And this number indicates the highest of the names in establishment and the lowest of them in descent, and that is His تعالى name Malik, if you consider its letters as utterance. But if you consider it numerically, then it is from the number 102, and it is even-odd plus whose parts are 136. And this number is qīm and maqām, which is “how much,” and qīm al-maqām, which is “be,” and so be. As for the names of its letters, they are 308, indicating to me...

(Chapter Sixty-Five on His Exalted Name, Wajid)
This name of lofty value, if one increases in its remembrance, nothing of what he desires to exist will be lost, and by it the wayfarers know
their souls. And whoever persists in its remembrance until a state of wajd overcomes him from it, will find in his inward a state he had not known before. And
it is known to be suitable as a remembrance for one whose name is Abd al-Wahid. It has the number 14, and an extended odd pair, because in it is a nobility
in that it is composed from the multiplication of the first even by the first complete number, so it is counted as seven twice. And it is the number
of the luminous letters and the nights of increase of light, because they are nights of wajd and the nights of decrease are nights of loss. And it is a deficient number;
its parts are 10, indicating the letter ya’, which is the name of the sublime revelation in His saying: “By Me he hears and by Me he sees.” Therefore
the likenesses of its letters indicate His saying: “He is the One who connects.” And this is its form as you see:

(Chapter Sixty-Seven on His Exalted Name, Wahid)
This self-sufficient name and spiritual secret: whoever increases in its remembrance
becomes estranged from multitude. And in it is a subtle secret for one who desires the barrenness of a man
or a woman from children; let him increase in its remembrance with that intention, and that will be obtained for him. So let him fear Allah تعالى. And it is among the adhkar
of the great ones. And the author of Taysir al-Matalib, قدس الله روحه, said: this name is among the nearest of names to the Essence,
and if it is added to the جامع name, it is among the greatest of remembrances and its most sublime. And it is a hint for one whose name is Ahmad.
And know that His name al-Wahid and al-Ahad is a noble remembrance, عظیم in شأن, for the wayfarers attached to the secrets of tawhid.
And Abu عبد الله al-Kufi said that His name al-Ahad is suitable for the people of annihilation in the حضرة of gathering, for they behold nothing except One.
And whoever increases in its remembrance, Allah تعالى opens tawhid for him. And this is its form as you see:

هذا الاسم العظيم الرباني والسر الكريم الصمداني من أكثر من

ذكره أمن مما يخاف واطمأنت نفسه واتسع قلبه ونور باطنه ومن

داوم على ذكره الى أن تصححه عوالمه وتذكر معه فانه لا يأتي الى أرض الأوتاد إلا أهابها بالبر

والطاعة ويحبه كل من رآه ويجيب دعوته كل من دعاه وفيه أسرار لأهل التوحيد وقال الشيخ

زين الدين الكافي من كتبه عدده والقمر زائد في النور في جام زجاج وأكثر من ذكره الى أن

يغلب عليه منه حال ومحاه بماء المطر وشربه وهو يطلب المكاشفات والمعارف النورانية ولم يخف

عليه من أمور العالم شيء الا أطلعه عليه في منامه أو يقظته بحسب اجتهاده فان كان صاحب

حالة صادقة وتوجه تام ارتفع عن باطنه حجاب القشر فلا يحتاج الى بيان معه بل ذلك كشف صريح محقق

ووصف صريح موفق واعلم أخرجك الله تعالى من درجات الكثائف الى درجات اللطائف ان كل باطن

فهو ظاهر بالنسبة الى ما هو أبطن منه فالأمر باطن الخلق ومن له الأمر والخلق باطن عنهما

فبطون الأمر اعتباري لا حقيقي والباطن حقيقة أمهما اذا سبحت سابحة من نوره أظهرت كل

باطن فيكون كأنه المختص بالظهور وهو المخصص بالبطون وعلى هذا فله البطون الذي

لا حد لانتهاءه وهذا الاسم له من العدد ٦٢ وهو زوج فرد ناقص أجزاؤه ٣٤ تشير الى باطن الإنسان

الذي هو قلبه اذ عددها ١٣٣ فهي تكتب قلب بعد قلب القرآن الذي العبارة عنه يس والى قلب

العالم الذي العبارة عنه محمد في بعض دون بعض الآخرين في وزن الآخرين

واسمه الباطن هو منشأ الوحدة والقلب محل ظهورها ومحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم أبطن

ما ظهر للخلق وأظهر ما بطن من الأمر وأما اعتبار آخر فهي تشير الى اسمه الميل والسنى وأما

مربعه فعلى هذه الصفة كما ترى بالصحيفة الآتية

**English:**

(Chapter Seventy-Five on His تعالى name al-Zahir)

This name of lofty rank and manifest secret: whoever mentions it often, Allah manifests to him

the hidden things of affairs, and by it the hidden treasures are extracted. And whoever engraves it on a sword and fights with it

will be the victor over his enemies, especially one of true state. And it has from the number 1006, and it is an even-odd deficient

number; its parts, 318, indicate two noble names, and they are Ghani, Basit. And know that His تعالى name al-Nur, al-Basit, and al-Zahir

are a remembrance for the people of unveilings. And whoever wishes to see something in his sleep, let him mention these names in complete purity

until a state from it overcomes him, and let him direct his resolve to what he wants, for that will be represented to him

in his sleep. And this is its form as you see.

(Chapter Seventy-Six on His تعالى name al-Batin)

This عظیم lordly name and the noble Samadani secret: whoever

mentions it often is secure from what he fears, his soul is tranquil, his heart expands, and his inward is illuminated. And whoever

persists in ذكره until his worlds are corrected and mention with him, then he does not come to the land of the awtad except that he incites it with righteousness

and obedience, and everyone who sees him loves him, and everyone who calls him is answered by his supplication. And in it are secrets for the people

of tawhid. And Shaykh

Zayn al-Din al-Kafi said from his books: its number, and the moon is increased in the light in a glass bowl, and he mentions it often until

a state from it overcomes him, and he erases it with rainwater and drinks it while he seeks unveilings and luminous knowledges, and nothing of the affairs of the world is hidden

from him except that he is informed of it in his sleep or waking according to his striving. If he is one of true

state and complete turning, the veil of the shell is lifted from his inward, so there is no need for explanation with it, rather that is a plain, verified unveiling

and a plain, successful description. And know—may Allah تعالى bring you out from the درجات of the dense to the درجات of the subtle—that every inward

is outward in relation to what is more inward than it. So the الأمر is inward to the creation, and whoever has the الأمر and the creation is inward from them.

So the inwardness of the الأمر is notional, not real, and the inward is in truth their mother when a swimmer from His light swims, it manifests every

inward, so it is as though it is exclusively for manifestation, while He is the one specified by inwardness. And upon this, it has the inwardness that

has no limit to its ending. And this name has from the number 62, and it is an even-odd deficient number; its parts, 34, indicate the inward of man,

which is his heart, since its number is 133, so it is written heart after heart of the Qur’an, which is expressed by YS, and to the heart

of the world, which is expressed by Muhammad, in some without some of the others in the weight of the others.

And His name al-Batin is the source of unity, and the heart is the locus of its manifestation, and Muhammad, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, is more inward

than what appeared to creation and more outward than what was inward of the الأمر. As for another consideration, they indicate its name al-Mil and al-Sana. And as for

its square, it is upon this description as you see on the following page.

( Chapter seventy-seven on His, تعالى, name al-Wali )
This great name and the ancient secret is suitable for the rulers, the poles, the successors, the shaykhs,
and the murids, and everyone who has a flock over whose affair he takes charge. And whoever increases in ذكره, he is awe-inspiring
among all creation. And whoever places this square on paper, and the moon is increasing in light, and mentions its number while he
seeks a ولاية, he attains it. And it is from the number 47, and it is the number of the seven alif-lams, because of what is in the ولاية of the laggards with him
and the forty, because of what is in it of the establishment of kingship. As for the names of its letters, they are 207, and it is a number that indicates al-Jabbar and al-Jabir
and points to them. As for its square, it is this description
Grid content preserved as-is

( Chapter seventy-eight on His, تعالى, name Muta‘al )
This name, lofty in rank, exalted in proof, whoever increases in ذكره and enters upon one
of the princes and rulers, he obtains from it abundant fortune. And it is suitable as a dhikr for whoever is exposed
to a dispute or a trial. And if it is written in a sheet of lead in the exaltation of Saturn or its house, and the name’s number is mentioned,
551, every obstinate one is subdued by it. And whoever increases in ذكره, hardships become easy for him and every difficult thing is humbled to him. And it has the number 551,
and it is an odd deficient number, its parts being 41, indicating two noble letters, and they are two letters that indicate the completion of
getting free from the bonds of ranks, which is the custom of exaltation. And it is a square number from the multiplication of the first perfect number by itself. As for
its letters, they indicate two noble names, and they are Mukram Rashid. And this is its form
Grid content preserved as-is

( Chapter seventy-nine on His, تعالى, name Barr )
This noble name and beautiful designation, whoever increases in ذكره is treated with kindness
in all his states, and blessings are multiplied upon him. And whoever writes it on a sheet of
white silver and carries it, asks Allah تعالى for something and He gives it to him. And in it is safety
for the traveler on land and sea. And if the traveler increases in ذكره, Allah makes the demands easy for him and makes his path easy for him, and he is
protected in his family and his wealth. And if the wind rages upon the people of the ship and they are on the verge of drowning, and they increase in ذكره,
the good wind comes to them. And if the drinker of wine or the doer of sins increases in it, Allah تعالى repents upon him and he turns back
from that. If he mentions it every day seven hundred times, then he repents from that and returns from it. And it has from the number 402, verbally 202,
numerically. As for the first number, it is an odd even number; the Beneficial, the Protector, the Rescuer, and the Restorer count it without them by three, and it is
among the increased numbers; its parts are 14, indicating the two names Majra al-Falak and the number. And the second number is odd even also, counted by the companion by two, and it is a deficient number; its parts 204 indicate its civil name and its name Ja‘il. As for its square, it is on
the following page

تعالى makes easy for him the return to his beginning. So it is fitting for every person that he not be devoid of ذكره in his day and his night.

And in it is a beautiful secret for driving flies away from the body. And it has the number 515, and it is an odd elongated number, its parts being

indicating our saying: He is Wise, the one of repentance from wisdom. And it also indicates our saying: Subbuh, since the return to the beginning

He تعالى said: Indeed Allah loves the repentant ones, the verse. And the names of its letters, 530, indicate two noble names, and they are Rafi‘

الذي يسرته على كثير من عبادك وأغنني بفضلك عمن سواك وواظب عليه ٤٠ يوماً أرسل الله له

وقيل له إن زدت زدناك وإن استكفيت كفيناك وذكر حجة الإسلام في الإحياء أن من قال بعد

(Chapter eighty-eight concerning His name, Rich)

Whoever increases in mentioning it until some of its worlds in the ذكر accord with him,

God enriches him from everything other than Him, and it is suitable as a ذكر for the people of beginnings and richness.

Among the names of characterizing is the Enricher, and among the names of realization is the Enricher. It has the number 1007

in word-form and 1066 in numeral-form. As for its verbal number, it is an even odd, deficient, its parts 128, indicating the Extender, Possessor of Majesty.

As for its numerical number, it is an even odd, increased, its parts 274, exceeding its root by His تعالى name, Enumerator. It has a square

of great benefit; the seekers of the greater richness know it. And this is its form

(Chapter eighty-nine concerning His تعالى name, Enricher)

Whoever increases in mentioning it, God makes easy for him his desire. And whoever writes it and carries it and mentions with it the name,

the number of its letters, and recites Surat al-Duha after that, and says: O God, make easy for the easy

which You have made easy upon many of Your servants, and enrich me by Your bounty from other than You, and persists upon it for 40 days, God sends to him

one who teaches him what he wants in his sleep or waking, according to his striving. And I mentioned that to a friend and indicated to him by mentioning

it, so he sat in seclusion mentioning the name for a long time; God made easy for him his desire, and what he needed of gold and dirhams came.

And it was said to him: if you increase, We increase you, and if you seek sufficiency, We suffice you. And Hujjat al-Islam mentioned in al-Ihya’ that whoever says after

the Friday prayer: O God, O Rich, O Praiseworthy, O Originator, O Restorer, O Doer of what He wills, O Loving, suffice me with Your lawful from

Your unlawful, and with Your obedience from Your disobedience, and by Your bounty from other than You, 70 times, and persists upon that, God enriches him. And whoever

writes it and carries it, his trade profits, ﷺ. And know that by the secrets of the names and their lights the earth is folded up and what is in it is uncovered; by it

customs are breached and wisdom is opened from whoever turns back. He تعالى said: And to God belong the Most Beautiful Names, so call upon Him by them. And He تعالى said: Call upon Me,

I will respond to you. And he عليه السلام said: supplication benefits from what has descended and from what has not descended. And he عليه السلام said: whoever does not supplicate

God, He غضب عليه. And he عليه السلام said: God does not tire until you tire. And it has from the number 1100, and its name corresponds to Possessor of Majesty

and Honor, because His تعالى description is beautiful. As for the names of its letters, they are 567, indicating two majestic names, and they are Compeller,

Makwur. And this is the description of its square, as you see.

(Chapter ninety-one concerning His تعالى name, Harmful)

This name is suitable for unleashing diseases and ailments if it is drawn and recited in the times suitable to it. And know that harm

by it, or issuing from an assembled inward and a gaze of majesty. It has the number 1001 in word-form, and it is the number 4868494

prime, and 1100 in numeral-form, and it is an odd number, deficient, its parts 1502, indicating Rich, Glorious ۞. And know that harm

is according to knowledge and encompassing; whoever’s knowledge is greater and his encompassing more complete, he is more effective. And whoever desires to be singular with this name

makes the harm of every harmful one a benefit for the harmed one, and what is arranged upon it of reward, recompense, and immediate and future interests.

Even if a person has an enemy and the blood overcomes his temperament until it nearly destroys his soul, so that if he remained in his state he would die

that night, then he hastens its harm, and harm from it, diminished from his blood, would be of the utmost benefit to him because of his ignorance of the place

of the harm; for there is no harmful one nor beneficial one in الحقيقة except God تعالى. And Abu عبد الله al-Kafi said: whoever places this name

the luminous in a sheet of lead on the first of Saturday in the burning of the month, and mentions the name, its number,

while he looks at the figure with a gaze of majesty and seeks the harm of any person he wills, then that will occur for him. And whoever is decreed

for him provision, there appears from him as the form of the attracting magnet from chest to chest, and God is the grantor. And this is its form

as you see.

(Chapter ninety-two concerning His تعالى name, Beneficial)

This noble beneficial name contains healing for every sick one and recovery for every afflicted one. So whoever

increases in mentioning it in a state of his harm, God تعالى grants him recovery. And if he is a person of a state

of charity and persists upon mentioning it until some of its worlds accord with him, then he does not pass his hand over a sick person except God

تعالى grants recovery. And whoever places from it in a silver ring in the exaltation of the moon and wears it, God تعالى grants him recovery. Do you not see

that there is no insult to His name upon one recovered? As for the names of its letters, they indicate two majestic names, and they are God, Healer, and it is written

around its square: And there has come down from the Qur’an that which is a healing and mercy for the believers, the verse. And it is suitable as a ذكر for one whose name is

Qasim. It has the number 501, and it is an odd elongated number whose side is three, and it is among the noblest numbers; its parts are 79,

indicating His name, Reckoner. And the names of its letters, 428, indicate His name, Severe in Might, and their increase over their named one,

and that is the name of the King of kings. It has a noble numerical triangle, purified by it, and a lettered square placed in the exaltation of the moon; so its bearer

sees from the wonders of God تعالى’s making what descriptions are unable to reach. And this is its form.

And whoever places the name of the sun in a numerical square and places within it His name

تعالى, Living, and carries it with him, his spirit is strengthened, his health is made lasting, and he is provided with awe

and dignity. And this is its form as you see.

( الفصل الثالث والتسعون في اسمه تعالى نور )

هذا الاسم الجليل الجذاب والسر الجميل الخلاب من أكثر من ذكره نور الله

تعالى قلبه بنور الإيمان ومن جمع اسمه النور والنافع في وفق وحمله شاهد

أموراً غريبة من أسرار الإمداد بالحياة باطناً وبالأهم ظاهراً وله من العدد ٢٥٦

وهو من الأسماء حروفه في مراتب أعداده وهو زوج مكعب ناقص عن أصله بواحد يشير إلى اسم

جبرائيل عليه السلام وإلى اسمين جليلين وهما دائم منهم وأما أسماء حروفه فتشير إلى اسمه تعالى

الفاطر بال وقال أبو عبد الله الطرابلسي قدس الله سره متى أهم على إنسان أمر أو ضل عن طريق

وذكر هذا الاسم بصحة عزم ونية صادقة أرشده الله تعالى إلى الطريق كلما قصد

ومن أكثر من ذكره أنار الله تعالى باطنه ونور ظاهره فإن كان صاحب حاجة صادقة ظهر النور

من قلبه على وجهه وصار يخرج النور من فمه حال الذكر حتى يملأ خلوته وما حولها وفي ذكره

أسرار لأرباب البدايات وأنوار لأهل النهايات ومن ذكره في بيت مظلم وعيناه مفتوحتان إلى أن

ومن أضاف إليه البديع وثلاثة بعد صوم ورياضة إلى أن يغلب عليه منه حال خلو

(Chapter ninety-three concerning His تعالى name, Light)

This noble, attractive name and the beautiful, captivating secret: whoever increases in mentioning it, God تعالى

illumines his heart with the light of faith. And whoever combines the name al-Nur and al-Nafi‘ in a wafq and carries it sees

strange matters from the secrets of support with life inwardly and, more importantly, outwardly. It has the number 256,

and it is among the names; its letters are in the ranks of its numbers, and it is an even cube deficient from its root by one, indicating the name

Gabriel عليه السلام and two noble names, and they are Everlasting among them. As for the names of its letters, they indicate His تعالى name

the Originator, with al-. And Abu عبد الله al-Tarabulsi, قدس الله سره, said: whenever a matter concerns a person or he strays from a path

and he mentions this name with sound resolve and sincere intention, God تعالى guides him to the path whenever he intends.

And whoever increases in mentioning it, God تعالى illuminates his inward and brightens his outward. If he is a person of a true need, the light appears

from his heart upon his face, and light begins to emerge from his mouth during the ذكر until it fills his seclusion and what is around it. In its ذكر

there are secrets for the people of beginnings and lights for the people of ends. And whoever mentions it in a dark house and his eyes are open until

a state from it overcomes him, he sees wondrous lights filling his heart, and it is a noble name suitable for the people of unveilings.

And whoever adds to it al-Badi‘ and three after fasting and spiritual discipline until a state of empty

stomach and purity of inward overcomes him from it, then it produces light, a lamp, and it is مخصوص to the people of insights among the people of God تعالى. And it has

a square of great value, known to the people of pure hearts, and this is its form.
